subject.title: build(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 3 updates

question: Should the macOS area accept these three grouped Swift package upgrades after the current-head native macOS checks complete successfully, or require them to be split for attribution?
rationale: The patch is a direct dependency-resolution update with no mechanical source repair indicated; selecting the acceptable upgrade and validation posture is an ownership and release-risk judgment.

options.title: Validate then merge
options.body: Wait for the current-head macOS Swift and scan checks to pass, then accept the grouped upstream pins as one routine dependency update.

options.title: Split the updates
options.body: Require separate dependency PRs if macOS reviewers need failure attribution or release-impact isolation for Sparkle versus the two Swift libraries.

options.title: Defer the group
options.body: Close or defer this update if the macOS release train is intentionally frozen and no security or compatibility requirement justifies the upgrades now.

recommendation.title: Validate then merge
recommendation.body: Wait for the current-head macOS Swift and scan checks to pass, then accept the grouped upstream pins as one routine dependency update.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is explicitly routed into the timeline for the macOS dependency review, though source-history ownership could not be independently established in the read-only environment.
